notes:
PocketScanTCG now identifies cards from a photo as well as by search.

- Scan the card front to match its artwork entirely on-device against the PKMNDB-hosted reference index, with ranked candidates and confidence.
- The APK reads the printed collector number from the warped card to separate printings that share the same artwork.
- The first scan downloads the ~70 MB index (Chinese shards skipped); later scans are offline.
- Optional AI identification fallback for foil/full-art cards, off by default and only used when the offline match is unsure.
- Settings: prefer Japanese printings, prepare/clear the scan index, AI identification toggle.
- Re-synced the PKMNDB catalogue snapshot (22,047 EN + 27,961 JA cards).

Debug build of the PocketScanTCG Android app (debug-signed). Sideload for testing.
